utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Redlands' by name among the cities in its service area. The City of Redlands' own Municipal Utilities and Engineering Department page confirms its utility operations are limited to 'Water Production and Distribution; Non-Potable Water Distribution; Wastewater Collection, Treatment, and Disposal' — i.e. no municipal electric utility — consistent with SCE serving as the electric provider.

generation_supplier.notes: No official Redlands city page or CCA program page confirming CCA membership was found this session. Left null rather than guessed.

county.notes: Redlands is a well-documented San Bernardino County city; also listed under San Bernardino County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Redlands Building & Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Redlands/San Bernardino County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Eligibility Checklist for Expedited Solar Photovoltaic Permitting (systems <= 10 kW AC, no battery backup)
Structural engineering calculations (footings and bolting specifications, required for systems > 10 kW AC and all ground-mounted installations)

value: Request building inspections via the online form at veribook.com/lp/CityOfRedlands
Inspectors answer phone questions between 7:00am and 8:00am daily, with inspection schedules posted after 8:00am

value.notes: Roof-mounted PV arrays 10 kW AC or less (no battery backup) qualify for same-day 'over the counter' review and permit issuance. Roof-mounted arrays over 10 kW AC, and all ground-mounted arrays, require formal plan review with a 10-business-day turnaround.

value.program_or_pathway: Over-the-counter expedited review (<=10 kW AC roof-mounted, no battery backup) / formal plan review (>10 kW AC roof-mounted, or any ground-mounted)
other_conditions: Structural engineering calculations are not required for single-family residences at or below the 10 kW AC roof-mounted threshold
Ground-mounted PV arrays always require mandatory structural engineering calculations for footings and bolting, regardless of size
